title: Noah's Ark
style: Pixar-style 3D animated film, soft global illumination, warm cinematic lighting, expressive stylized characters, rich detailed textures, shallow depth of field, smooth gentle camera motion, high quality animation
noah: Noah, a kind old man with a long white beard, warm brown eyes and a simple brown hooded robe

scenes.narration: Long ago, the world had filled with violence, and people had forgotten God.
scenes.prompt: an ancient walled city at dusk, crowds of people arguing and shoving in a torch-lit market street, {noah} watching sadly from a doorway, slow push-in camera

scenes.narration: But one man still walked with God. His name was Noah.
scenes.prompt: {noah} kneeling in prayer on a quiet green hill at golden sunset, wind moving the grass and his robe, slow orbiting camera

scenes.narration: One night, God spoke to him. A great flood is coming. Build an ark.
scenes.prompt: {noah} standing alone under a starry night sky, looking up in awe as golden light breaks through swirling clouds and shines on his face, camera slowly tilting up

scenes.narration: So Noah obeyed. Day after day, he and his sons cut and hammered wood.
scenes.prompt: {noah} and three young bearded men hammering huge wooden beams of a giant ark frame in a sunny valley, sawdust in the air, wide shot, camera slowly tracking sideways

scenes.narration: His neighbours laughed at the giant boat on dry land. Noah kept building.
scenes.prompt: villagers laughing and pointing at an enormous half-built wooden ark on dry dusty land, {noah} calmly carrying a plank past them, low angle wide shot

scenes.narration: Then the animals came, two by two, from every corner of the earth.
scenes.prompt: pairs of elephants, giraffes, lions, zebras and birds walking in a long line up a wooden ramp into a giant ark, golden afternoon light, dust in the air, sweeping crane shot

scenes.narration: Noah, his family and every creature went inside, and the great door closed.
scenes.prompt: the huge wooden door of the ark slowly closing from inside, {noah} and his family looking back through the gap at darkening clouds, warm lantern light inside

scenes.narration: The sky turned black, and the rain began. For forty days and forty nights.
scenes.prompt: dark storm clouds rolling over the giant wooden ark, heavy rain pouring down, lightning flashing across the sky, water rising around the hull, dramatic wide shot

scenes.narration: The waters rose over the hills and mountains, but the ark floated safely on.
scenes.prompt: a giant wooden ark floating on an endless stormy ocean, huge waves, mountain peaks disappearing under water, rain and mist, aerial drone shot slowly circling

scenes.narration: Inside, Noah cared for every animal, waiting, and trusting God.
scenes.prompt: cozy interior of the ark lit by warm hanging lanterns, {noah} gently feeding an elephant with an apple, giraffes, rabbits and parrots on wooden decks around him, hay on the floor

scenes.narration: At last the rain stopped. Noah sent out a dove, and it came back with an olive leaf.
scenes.prompt: a white dove flying toward the camera over calm shining water at sunrise, holding a green olive leaf in its beak, {noah} smiling at the ark window behind, soft morning light

scenes.narration: The ark came to rest, and Noah's family stepped onto dry ground once more.
scenes.prompt: {noah} and his family stepping off the ark onto green grass on a mountainside, animals running out behind them into the sunlight, joyful, wide shot, gentle camera pull back

scenes.narration: And God set a rainbow in the sky, a promise that the flood would never return.
scenes.prompt: a brilliant rainbow arching across a clear blue sky above the wooden ark resting on a green mountain, {noah} and his family looking up in wonder, camera slowly rising
